Native Model Context Protocol

Your AI client becomes your command line for the business.

SuperStack OS ships a native MCP server. Connect once, and ChatGPT, Claude or Grok can call your real business tools in real time — with permissions, logging and human approval where you want it.

  1. STEP 01

    Connect your AI client

    Paste your SuperStack OS MCP endpoint into ChatGPT, Claude or Grok. Authenticate with a scoped API key — choose exactly which tools and contacts each client can touch.

    mcp.superstackos.com/v1/your-workspace
  2. STEP 02

    Ask in plain language

    "Find every lead who opened last week's email but didn't book, call them with the Voice agent, and send the ones who answer a 15% loyalty pass." That's a real instruction, not a demo.

  3. STEP 03

    Tools execute in real time

    The AI client calls SuperStack OS tools — search contacts, launch campaign, create invoice, trigger automation, generate content, issue wallet pass — and receives structured results instantly.

    contacts.search voice.call stripe.invoice wallet.issuePass
  4. STEP 04

    Everything is logged on the record

    Every action lands on the contact timeline, the audit log and your dashboard. Approve sensitive actions with a tap, roll back mistakes, and watch your business run itself.

FAQ

Straight answers.

What exactly is MCP and why does it matter?

Model Context Protocol is the open standard AI clients like ChatGPT, Claude and Grok use to call external tools. SuperStack OS ships a native MCP server, so your AI assistant can search contacts, launch campaigns, place calls, create invoices and more — securely, in real time, with structured results. Read the plain-English guide.

Can I migrate my existing CRM and email lists?

Yes. Import contacts, tags, deals and notes via CSV or our importer, and connect your existing Stripe account in one click. Growth and Agency plans include guided migration.

How does white-label work for agencies?

On the Agency plan you get your own domain, logo, colors, email sender and pricing. Each client receives a sub-account with their own agents, automations and MCP endpoint — branded entirely as you. SuperStack OS is never visible to your clients. See the agency guide.

Is my data safe when AI agents take actions?

Every tool call is permission-scoped, rate-limited and logged. You decide which actions run automatically and which require human approval. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and you can revoke any client's access instantly.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. All plans are month-to-month with no contracts. Export your data anytime — it's yours.
